interpretation: This plan describes statistics on the fixed200-row enrichment. It is not an executed report, a synthetic source cohort or verified execution replay. The13 source_checks entries are the reviewed native execution scope. Other diagnostics below are proposals only, not implemented or promised by the controller. No pass/fail tolerance is proposed; source discrepancies are transport diagnostics, not desired target values.
selection_convention: Each selection array is an AND of named-column comparisons. eq means equality; ge and le compare inclusive numeric bounds. No survey weights. All numeric operators use missing_policy error; the required output has no missing values.

source_covariate_context_checks.estimator: Arithmetic mean of bmi in each matching race/sex stratum, all ages20-56, no weights and no missing values
source_covariate_context_checks.purpose: Describe fixed-covariate transport differences; these values are already observed and must never be repaired to match source.

source_covariate_context_checks.purpose: Describe composition differences only; not generated-outcome checks.

additional_diagnostics_without_source_nu.derived_columns: male=1 if sex male else0; black=1 if race Black else0. z_bmi=(bmi-mean(bmi))/sample_sd(bmi); z_urate=(urate-mean(urate))/sample_sd(urate), using all200 and ddof1.
additional_diagnostics_without_source_nu.estimator: OLS z_urate on intercept,z_bmi,age,male,black; report coefficient of z_bmi with unit1. Equivalently raw BMI coefficient from urate~bmi+age+male+black multiplied by sample_sd(bmi)/sample_sd(urate).
additional_diagnostics_without_source_nu.limitation: Omits smoking/alcohol and changes cohort composition. Does not execute the original mediation model and does not establish matching0.322.

additional_diagnostics_without_source_nu.derived_columns: male=1 if male else0; black=1 if Black else0
additional_diagnostics_without_source_nu.estimator: OLS urate on intercept,bmi,age,male,black; report bmi coefficient mg/dL per kg/m^2 and age coefficient mg/dL per year. Also fit within each sex urate~intercept+bmi+age+black.
additional_diagnostics_without_source_nu.purpose: Describe the fictional data's adjusted relations without suggesting that age effects were measured in sources.

additional_diagnostics_without_source_nu.derived_columns: bmi_c=bmi-30; age_c=age-38; bmi_c2=bmi_c*bmi_c; male=1 if male else0; black=1 if Black else0; bmi_c_male=bmi_c*male; age_c_male=age_c*male
additional_diagnostics_without_source_nu.estimator: OLS urate on intercept,bmi_c,bmi_c2,age_c,male,black,bmi_c_male,age_c_male. Report bmi_c2 in mg/dL per (kg/m^2)^2 and interaction coefficients in mg/dL per kg/m^2 and mg/dL per year. This quadratic diagnostic is distinct from the working hinge formula.
additional_diagnostics_without_source_nu.purpose: Describe possible finite-table curvature and sex interaction; no source-calibrated coefficient or significance goal.

additional_diagnostics_without_source_nu.estimator: Arithmetic mean, sample SD(ddof1), minimum/maximum and linear sample quantiles q0.10,0.25,0.50,0.75,0.90 (Hyndman-Fan type7); mg/dL. Source mean/SD comparisons are only those explicitly declared above; no admitted published quantiles are available.
additional_diagnostics_without_source_nu.purpose: Inspect spread, ties and tails without inventing source percentile references.

additional_diagnostics_without_source_nu.estimator: For each row subtract the working conditional-location formula in model_spec. Report arithmetic residual mean and sample residual SD(ddof1), plus residual associations with age and bmi as descriptive Pearson r. These are deviations from an assumed guide, not residuals of a fitted source model.
additional_diagnostics_without_source_nu.purpose: Describe whether later direct authorship introduced obvious patterns. The source marginal SD is not a residual-SD comparator.
